info.name: PlanRadar's API Documentation Approval Requests V2 List V2 API

items.docs:
Updates a specific list by its id. This endpoint uses a draft-based workflow that requires 3 sequential requests with the same temp-uuid:

**Step 1 - Initialize draft:** Send `init_draft: true` with a client-generated `temp-uuid` to copy existing entries into a draft table.

**Step 2 - Modify entries:** Send one or more requests with the same `temp-uuid` to add, update, or delete entries in the draft.
- To add/update an entry: include an `item` object with `name`, `uuid`, `parent-id`, and `order

info.name: Returns all lists of a specific project

params.name: last_sync_date
params.description: is a Unix Timestamp. If it is set, only lists that were created after that timestamp will be returned

params.name: page
params.description: sets the number of pages for the returned lists

params.name: pagesize
params.description:
sets the number of lists that should be returned per page
Maximum is 500, default is 100

params.name: disable_relations
params.description: Returns only the ticket_type_lists without loading the list entries, which would make the API faster

items.docs: This API returns all lists that are attached to the ticket types that are used by a specific project based on its id.
